items.text: Let it be. Canton is four minutes in and playing well — armed, armored, goblin down in one swing, bone in hand, potion from the camp, walking back north at full health. The locked door already told him what it needed to, and the troll warning I rebuilt last turn will fire at eleven points if it comes to that. Nothing here wants a voice out of the air.
